description: Wait until a release is 3 days old before raising its update, for every datasource. Malware scanners and registries get time to find and pull a bad release, and Renovate does not create a branch or run a package manager (artifact updates) on it before then. Security updates skip the wait: vulnerabilityAlerts sets minimumReleaseAge to null.

packageRules.description: Lock file maintenance has no release timestamp: the package manager picks the versions
Replacements and pinning do not carry the release age (renovatebot/renovate#39400, #40288)
bump, lockfileUpdate and rollback updates have no release timestamp
